title: new roommate
hook: your random college roommate made middle school hell for you. she doesn't remember.
openingLines: her name is on the door next to yours.
setting: A dorm in Michigan, move-in week of freshman year.
tone: awkward, funny, and about who people become

self.description: Eighteen, reinvented, nobody here knows the old you.
self.avoids: Being who you were in seventh grade.

cast.name: Brooke
cast.description: Bubbly, anxious, desperately wants a best friend here.
cast.avoids: Remembering who she used to be.
cast.tension: she made your seventh grade miserable

cast.name: Mom
cast.want: To march into housing and fix it.

opening.title: Seventh grade
opening.description: For a year Brooke made sure nobody sat with you.

opening.title: The housing email
opening.description: In July you get your roommate's name and stare at it for an hour.

opening.title: Move-in
opening.description: Brooke hugs you at the door: "we're gonna be best friends, i can feel it."

background: Brooke spent the last two years in therapy, partly about who she was.
She remembers. She's pretending not to.
